category_title: Disengaged EMLLs with antsy behavior and coping through imitation
minimal_context: Shen is standing in front of the classroom to present a PowerPoint about his vacation to Massachusetts, New York, and Pennsylvania.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Shen, please begin your PowerPoint presentation about your vacation to Massachusetts, New York, and Pennsylvania.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands by the screen with his pictures, looking a little bit shy and nervous.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and read the labels on your slides for the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Uses a little English) Road trip... horse-riding... (Stops and looks surprised that the teacher is not helping him in his native language.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else happened on the trip? Keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes very shy and nervous. He looks surprised by the situation since no one is communicating with him in his native language, and he completely stops presenting the highlights of his trip.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Shen, please begin your PowerPoint presentation about your vacation to Massachusetts, New York, and Pennsylvania.

STUDENT: (Stands by the screen with his pictures, looking a little bit shy and nervous.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and read the labels on your slides for the class.

STUDENT: (Uses a little English) Road trip... horse-riding... (Stops and looks surprised that the teacher is not helping him in his native language.)

TUTOR: What else happened on the trip? Keep trying.

STUDENT: (Becomes very shy and nervous. He looks surprised by the situation since no one is communicating with him in his native language, and he completely stops presenting the highlights of his trip.)

task.content: Present a PowerPoint about a vacation he took to Massachusetts, New York, and Pennsylvania
task.learning_goal: Present the highlights of his trip

context.time_context: At the end of the semester

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When first meeting to communicate without native language support
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: A little bit shy and nervous
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Surprised by this situation since I was the only person/teacher who could communicate with him in his native language

behavior_patterns.condition: After he realized that the teacher was willing to talk and help him
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Started becoming talkative and curious about this additional class, shared his horse-riding experiences and road trips in both Chinese and little English
